about: Every pair the old late-pairing rule merged (same kind class, within 30 s, the same 3-word line of his - or, for word slips, the same word from Amal), re-validated under the rule of 2026-10-05: merge only with evidence of the same error (same rule, or the same wrong / right piece), one partner each.

rows.why: merged: the same line of his and the same piece, written in the two alphabets
rows.read_by_hand: same slip: both rows are the extra 'min' after khaaf before a verb (Amal: 'here you don't need min'); the readers wrote it in Latin under C11, the sweep in Arabic under D2 - one error, filed under two rules

readers_row.medi_said: ‹Ahna il tinen›, ‹bin khaf, bin khaf min, is it ‹nakun ahel›?
readers_row.amal_said: Oh, here ‹hala ma btihtaj min›. ‹Bin khaf nakun›.
readers_row.why: khaaf takes min before a noun, but before a verb no min; she said 'here you don't need min' and he said bin khaf nikun.

sweep_row.medi_said: ‹Ahna il tinen›, ‹bin khaf, bin khaf min, is it ‹nakun ahel›?
sweep_row.amal_said: Oh, here ‹hala ma btihtaj min›. ‹Bin khaf nakun›.
sweep_row.why: kept min before a verb after khaaf (min only before a noun)

readers_row.why: Amal asked if he remembered متعب, he said No, she supplied 'tiring' (sheet: tiring | Mut3eb | متعب) and he said 'Oh, that's right'. Didn't-know, tier 0.

readers_row.why: He garbled the word Amal had given at 09:10 (كهربجي, also said as كرهبجي at 09:30); she recast it syllable by syllable. He attempted it, so not tier 0; wrong form of a word just given = tier 2.

readers_row.amal_said: One star is نجمة. What's multiple؟ ... نجوم.
readers_row.why: Didn't-know: he first guessed عاصفة (storm) as a question at 09:03-09:08, then asked for 'stars'; Amal gave نجمة and, after his guess أنجم (09:30), the plural نجوم (sheet: star | Nejme | نجمة).

readers_row.medi_said: Uh, but fatad means, like, you choose? ... So I know bafadal. Is it one of my words?
readers_row.why: Amal asked 'امتى بتفضل؟' (08:46); he did not recognise it (thought it meant 'you choose') and asked; she explained 'when do you prefer' and 'بفضل I prefer' - a sheet word ('i prefer | Ana bafaddel | أنا بفضل') he did not catch on listening.

readers_row.wrong: Who was he mad with you
readers_row.medi_said: Who was he mad with you-- at you? I don't... This doesn't make sense.
readers_row.amal_said: What's ضايقك؟ ... So is it ضايق or it's ضايقة to be upset؟ ... So مين ضايقك؟
readers_row.why: Listening: he could not parse ضايقك; Amal asked which form is 'to be upset' and he worked out اتضايق = get upset vs ضايق = make someone upset, landing on 'who made you upset' at 28:17 - the make-X vs get-X distinction.

sweep_row.medi_said: Who was he mad with you-- at you? I don't... This doesn't make sense.
sweep_row.amal_said: So is it ضايق or it's ضايقة to be upset؟ ... So مين ضايقك؟
sweep_row.why: (listening drill) read causative ضايق as 'be upset'

readers_row.wrong: كمان نص ساعة = half hour more
readers_row.right: كمان نص ساعة = in half an hour
readers_row.medi_said: آآآ in a half آآآ in half hour more.
readers_row.amal_said: No. If I say كمان شوي what does it mean؟ ... So كمان نص ساعة means in an, in half an hour يعني. After half an hour.
readers_row.why: She asked 'شو يعني كمان نص ساعة؟' (28:21); he gave the wrong meaning, she said No and taught it - listening, comprehension.
